source_crs: EPSG:3857 verified from .prj, despite WGS84 filename
selection: Whole valid polygon parts with representative point inside the official municipality. Boundary-crossing footprints remain whole and are recorded. No geometry repair, synthetic height, lake fill or missing-anchor extrapolation.
placement: Illustrative level base sampled bilinearly at source footprint representative point on the 64 m CGVD2013 terrain grid. Source AVG_HEIGHT retained unchanged. SURF_ELEV and HEIGHT_MSL are not used or datum-converted. Flat foundations may intersect local slopes; no bridge/actor/collision changes.

limits: Relative source AVG_HEIGHT is unchanged; no assumption that source SURF_ELEV or HEIGHT_MSL is CGVD2013.

Terrain-relative level bases are illustrative, may intersect slopes and do not establish surveyed foundations or structural/collision clearances.
Buildings are near-detail context, not citywide interacting traffic. Existing 510 replay and flat district remain separate.
